text.text_excerpt: No, this is not a fancy, beautiful, well maintained hotel like some of the others in the Quarter. That being said, this place was affordable, a very quick walk to Bourbon, the beds and linens were clean and comfortable, and I would definitely stay here again. I have previously been adamant about not staying on "the other side of Canal Street" but after this stay I have no qualms with it. I thought the walk was quick and simple, and I did not feel unsafe taking the walk. The restrooms in the room are a bit small and lack in counter space, but there is a shelving unit above the toilet to store all of your toiletries. After I checked out I hit up the continental breakfast. Not too shabby! To...

This is really nice and clean 'boutique' hotel. I've read some reviews bitching about the hotel not having a restaurant or other amenities the 'others' might have, but the truth is, when you stay here, you're literally a minute away from everything. The staff is friendly, the rooms are nice and reasonably priced. Good enough for me.

Oh how I loved my stay here, it made my NOLA experience that much better. Don't get me wrong this isn't a 5 star hotel however, the kind and knowledgeable staff, responsive valet parking team and easy walking distance to the French Quarter combine to make this hotel a top choice. That being said our stay wasn't without incident. We were a little confused about where to park but, luckily we pulled into the alley and the valet guy was quick to help us sign up for valet which is a must if you are staying here.
